effects.lua_implementation: Fusion material metadata requires exactly two exact Tokens with Level at least 1.

official_references.matched_structure: First of the Dragons supplies repeated exact-two Fusion material structure.

effects.printed_clause: Must first be Special Summoned from Extra Deck by Tributing those materials while controlling To Proto Ataxia; no Polymerization.
effects.lua_implementation: Revive limit/SPSUMMON_CONDITION plus custom Extra SPSUMMON_PROC checks exact face-up Ataxia, selects exactly two releasable legal Tokens, records and releases them.

official_references.matched_structure: Chimeratech Fortress Dragon is an official no-Polymerization Extra Deck procedure.

effects.printed_clause: If monster(s) loses ATK/DEF, this card gains ATK/DEF equal to amount lost.
effects.lua_implementation: Continuous UPDATE_ATTACK and UPDATE_DEFENSE values sum each current face-up monster's deficit from GetBaseAttack/GetBaseDefense.

official_references.matched_structure: Leeching the Light demonstrates deriving a live ATK modification from current field monster stats.

effects.issue: Unresolved design/engine gap: the printed event-like phrase does not define duration or accumulation, and Omega exposes no official ATK/DEF-loss event from which to record historical losses. The current script models live deficits only.

effects.printed_clause: Can attack all opponent monsters once each.

official_references.matched_structure: Machine Lord Ür uses the exact attack-all-once-each implementation.

effects.printed_clause: If Special Summoned from Extra Deck: add to hand or send an Ataxia Spell/Trap from Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed summon trigger checks Summon location Extra, selects a set S/T legal for at least one destination and offers add/confirm or send.

official_references.matched_structure: Elemental HERO Stratos supplies summon-trigger Deck selection; Foolish Burial supplies send branch.
Sends a selected monster from Deck to the GY; the alternative branch adds it to hand.
